recordedMeasurementsTransparentTransform: Recorded measurements, transparent transformations, and the mathematics behind each analysis.
centeredCrossProductDividedByTheProductO: Centered cross-product divided by the product of centered vector lengths. Describes linear association from −1 to +1. Undefined when either variable is constant. Binary/numeric Pearson is the point-biserial correlation.
pearsonCorrelationOfAverageRanksIncludin: Pearson correlation of average ranks, including tied ratings. Describes monotonic association and is less sensitive to extreme magnitudes. It does not remove confounding.
xDXD1OnlyWhenBothActual: x(d) − x(d−1), only when both actual calendar dates are recorded. Useful for separating changes from sustained level differences.
fitEachAlignedVariableToAnInterceptAndEl: Fit each aligned variable to an intercept and elapsed days, then correlate the residuals. Removes linear co-trending, not all trends or confounders.
arithmeticMeanOfAll7Or28CalendarDays: Arithmetic mean of all 7 or 28 calendar days ending on the relevant date. A single missing/excluded day makes the mean unknown. Overlapping windows share data; the bootstrap block is at least the window length.
aPredictorOnDateDIsPairedWithAn: A predictor on date d is paired with an outcome on d + lag. Sleep is recorded on the waking date. Lag is timing, not proof of causation.
resampleContiguousCalendarBlocksPreservi: Resample contiguous calendar blocks, preserving within-block pairs and missing slots. Take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 200 reproducible replicates. Approximate under local stationarity, not a Bayesian credible interval or a multiple-testing correction.
theModeledOutcomeDifferenceForAOneUnitIn: The modeled outcome difference for a one-unit input difference, holding other selected inputs fixed. Proper Normal–Inverse-Gamma priors shrink coefficients and yield Student-t marginals. Coefficients describe the chosen model, not interventions.
meanAbsolutePredictionErrorSquareRootOfM: Mean absolute prediction error; square root of mean squared error; fraction of later observations inside predictive intervals. Compared on chronologically held-out data. Low in-sample error alone does not show forecast skill.
builtInNumericAndCategoricalInputsPlusYo: {{value0}} built-in numeric and categorical inputs, plus your reusable context labels.
publishedMethodsExplainTheMathematicsAnd: Published methods explain the mathematics and measurement concepts. They do not validate this application, its project-defined scales, a particular user’s forecast, or a causal relationship. No readiness, longevity, injury-risk or medical-treatment score is inferred. Custom context labels are explicit presence/absence indicators, with unknown kept separate.
